name: io.github.kaiwena-sudo/archibase
title: Archibase floor plans
description: Structured, license-clean floor plan data for AI agents. Pay per call in USDC via x402.

environmentVariables.name: ARCHIBASE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key (ak_…) issued on request for trials and partners, instead of a wallet. Don't set together with ARCHIBASE_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: ARCHIBASE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated spending wallet holding a little USDC on Base. Without it, paid tools only report prices.

environmentVariables.name: ARCHIBASE_EXPECTED_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Trusted receiver address for wallet payments. Required with ARCHIBASE_PRIVATE_KEY; verify it through a trusted project channel.

environmentVariables.name: ARCHIBASE_BUDGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Maximum total spend per session in US dollars (default 2)

environmentVariables.name: ARCHIBASE_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Maximum price of a single call in US dollars (default 0.25)

environmentVariables.name: ARCHIBASE_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: eip155:8453 (Base, default) or eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia testnet)
